model_type: strategic allocation planning range; no point expected-return or cash-distribution forecast

active_base_core.role: inactive unless separate project gates pass
watchlist only; later ETF replacement capped at 15% aggregate

designated_model_instrument_boundary: The named instruments and cash/deposit implementation are model targets with target notionals and staged actions. They are not broker orders, live-price instructions, target prices, return forecasts or suitability conclusions.

formula_only_total_return_sensitivity.parameter_r_definition: r is a hypothetical annualized nominal total-return parameter before tax, transaction costs and fund fees; it is not a forecast, cash-distribution estimate or record of realized cash.
formula_only_total_return_sensitivity.output_boundary: The formula output is gross arithmetic sensitivity only. It does not populate D0 or any future cash-flow ledger.

actual_cash_ledger_contract.D0_definition: sum of past-12-month actual after-tax, after-fee cash receipts
actual_cash_ledger_contract.Dh_rule: D_h = D0 * (1 - h) may be calculated only from a populated actual D0 ledger for h in {0, 0.25, 0.50, 1.00}; it is not derived from r.
actual_cash_ledger_contract.forward_boundary: No forward distribution, withdrawal or household-income forecast is produced.

direct_high_dividend_stocks.current_model_treatment: excluded from active_base_core, planning_return_range, cash_distribution_policy and compounding illustrations

required_checks: minimum trading-unit, spread and fee economics
no single project or manager concentration red line
public_reits.inactive_behavior: REIT weight remains zero and the full 35% rate-bond allocation remains in place; no automatic purchase or rotation is permitted

compounding_illustrations.cash_ledger_link: none; r sensitivity and D0 ledger are separate

cash_distribution_policy.actual_measure: D0 = sum of past-12-month after-tax, after-fee cash receipts
cash_distribution_policy.boundary: A future spending or withdrawal plan requires a separate after-tax cash-flow model.

stress_model_reference: analysis/scenario_model.md; base-core common-stress result -16.30%, or CNY32600 on fixed principal, is a scenario output only and does not trigger observed-drawdown controls
